title: At the Market
setting: A busy outdoor market with many food and clothes stalls.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Lucy
characters.look: Lucy, a young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress

sentences.en: Zoe and her sister Lucy go to the market.
sentences.zh: 佐伊和她的姐姐露西去集市。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Lucy, a young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress walk into a busy outdoor market.

sentences.en: First, they get money from the bank.
sentences.zh: 首先，她们从银行取了钱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Lucy, a young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress take money from a cash machine outside a bank.

sentences.en: Many people sell fruit and fresh bread here.
sentences.zh: 很多人在这里卖水果和新鲜面包。
sentences.scene_prompt: Market stalls full of fruit and fresh bread, with sellers behind them.

sentences.en: Lucy has a question about the price of apples.
sentences.zh: 露西想问问苹果的价格。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lucy, a young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress asks a fruit seller a question, pointing at red apples.

sentences.en: The apples are cheap, only ten cents each.
sentences.zh: 苹果很便宜，每个只要十美分。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lucy, a young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress gives a few small coins to the fruit seller for apples.

sentences.en: Zoe likes some jeans, but they are expensive.
sentences.zh: 佐伊喜欢一条牛仔裤，但是很贵。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt holds up a pair of jeans at a clothes stall with a surprised face.

sentences.en: She does not want to spend forty dollars.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt puts the jeans back and shakes her head, holding her purse.

sentences.en: They share a rich cheese pizza for lunch.
sentences.zh: 她们一起吃了一份浓郁的芝士比萨当午饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Lucy, a young girl with long brown hair and a blue dress share a cheesy pizza at a market food stall.
